If all required rights/display fields are already present in the schema (i.e., overlay.schema_follow_up.required is false), the generated markdown still claims that the schema lacks these fields and lists an empty set of missing fields. Add a conditional check to output a clean message when no schema follow-up is required.

```javascript
function buildSchemaFollowupMarkdown({ overlay }) {
  if (!overlay.schema_follow_up.required) {
    return [
      '# SourceFigureAsset Rights Display Schema Follow-Up',
      '',
      'Generated: ' + overlay.generated_at,
      '',
      'All required rights/display fields are already present in the SourceFigureAsset schema.',
    ].join('\n');
  }
  return [
    '# SourceFigureAsset Rights Display Schema Follow-Up',
    '',
    'Generated: ' + overlay.generated_at,
    '',
    'SourceFigureAsset schema lacks rights/display fields required to make rights policy first-class on figure assets.',
    '',
    '## Missing Fields',
    '',
    ...overlay.schema_follow_up.source_figure_asset_schema_missing_fields.map((field) => '- ' + String.fromCharCode(96) + field + String.fromCharCode(96)),
    '',
    '## Boundary',
    '',
    '- This follow-up note does not approve any asset for student display.',
    '- It records schema debt so later SourceFigureAsset materialization can keep visual fidelity, receipt replay, and rights/display policy as separate axes.',
  ].join('\n');
}
```
Fixed in f3676a85b by normalizing CRLF to LF when reading existing artifacts before generated-content comparison. Re-ran the targeted test, builder check, ESLint, and diff checks successfully.
